review.notes: Word-level cross-check of all 43 physical PDF pages found no dropped body text or table content; unmatched extraction words are vector text inside chart figures (benchmark labels in Figures 1/5/6, pie percentages on p8, layer counts on p3), which the embedded figures already show. Reference section (pages 25-35) was diffed entry-by-entry, the appendix license list (pages 36-43) against printed names/keys. Pages 4, 5, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18 (600-dpi zoom), 26, 30, 32, 33, 37, 38, 40 and 42 were rendered and visually checked. Main repairs: all 14 page-bottom footnote URL bodies restored (markers had survived, bodies dropped); garbled names in the two giant reference author lists (Humanity's Last Exam, pages 30-33) including lost commas/spaces and 56 full-width commas; l->1 misread in '12-norm' (PDF text layer searches 'l2-norm' but not '12-norm'; the aggregation is the printed l2-norm with norm bars in equations on pages 18-19); license name/key misreads. W_1 on page 18 was visually re-verified at 300 dpi as the printed digit 1 and kept. The paper prints 'comparsions' (page 12) and 'Nemotron-h' (page 29) as its own spellings; the OCR had silently corrected 'comparsions' to 'comparisons', which is restored here, while 'Nemotron-h' was already faithful. Figure-internal chart text and '\- ' bullet style were left unchanged.
